rationale: The agent verified identity using first name, last name, and zip, matching to a single user ID before proceeding. It retrieved the user’s orders with read-only tools, identified the delivered order containing the office chair, and sought explicit confirmation before any write action. When the user hesitated about a return, the agent did not proceed. Upon the user’s change to an exchange, the agent clearly stated the intended change (exchange for the same item, using the original payment method for any difference) and obtained explicit confirmation before executing the exchange tool call. The action targeted the authenticated user’s own order and used the stored payment method. The final message confirmed submission of the exchange and provided correct next-step expectations. While some item details (options) were mentioned that we cannot fully verify due to truncated tool outputs, there is no clear evidence of fabrication affecting the outcome. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
